Any missing ACK/error/UNKNOWN stops new admissions; no business replay, alternate key or replacement job.

archivalProtocol.exactOriginalSDKBeforeAnyParsing: Immediately write and fsync every complete original SDK representation to its local durable journal, preserving embedded native raw text losslessly. A local persistence failure stops admissions. Then inspect isError and parse losslessly.
archivalProtocol.sameObserverPages: Continue only the already returned original operation_id and exact immutable offsets, one call at a time. Do not replay the native read. Git archival repair may recover identical bytes only and never triggers a native retry.
